context:
Goal: the Orphaned composer passes Apple's contrast audit without hiding a real failure.
Problem (rule): the option text says composer audit only, but the code keeps one shared list of skipped checks that the ready screen audit also reads, so skipping there also skips the ready screen; only your word says which reach you ruled.
Based on (read): the designer found that the ready audit already reads the shared list, which already holds the Cancel button.
Departs from: main skips the Cancel button in the shared list — this adds the Save button and the count, either there or only in the composer's own audit.
Waiting on: your answer on the Orphaned composer contrast question. This matters only if you pick the named skips there.
